summary: The implementation does not satisfy any of the 7 acceptance criteria for live preview. The core defect is that onEntryChange callbacks discard the actual entry data from the SDK — `setLivePreviewContent((prev) => ({ ...prev }))` and `setContent((prev) => ({ ...prev } as T))` both create shallow clones of empty/null state without capturing the entry argument. Additionally, useContent.getContentByKey has no override lookup logic, so even if data were captured it would never reach components. The prescribed server-side Stack live_preview configuration is entirely missing. useLivePreviewContent is dead code with the same discard bug. No unit tests exist for any changed file. The diff also removes the livePreview field from the context interface, which is the opposite of the prescribed fix. The implementation must be reworked to: (1) capture entry data in the onEntryChange callback, (2) deep-merge it into the context value, (3) have getContentByKey consult the merged content, (4) configure server-side Stack with live_preview, and (5) add unit tests covering all 7 acceptance criteria.

issues.description: The onEntryChange callback discards the actual preview entry data. `setLivePreviewContent((prev) => ({ ...prev }))` creates a shallow clone of existing state (always null/empty), ignoring any entry data the SDK provides. The livePreviewContent state is never populated with real content, so no live updates can reach consuming components. None of the 7 acceptance criteria about live updates can be satisfied.
issues.suggestedFix: The onEntryChange callback must capture the entry data from the SDK and merge it into the content tree. Per the prescribed fix, the callback should receive the updated entry and deep-merge it into the context value so all 236+ consuming components re-render with the preview data. Investigate the SDK's actual callback signature — it may provide the entry as an argument or via a separate method like `LivePreview.getEntry()`.

issues.description: useContent.getContentByKey has no live preview override logic — it just calls `getValue(content, path, defaultValue)`. Even if the ContentstackProvider captured preview data, no component would see it because getContentByKey never consults any preview override bag. The diff also REMOVES the `livePreview` field from IContentstackContext and removes the override lookup, which is the opposite of the prescribed fix.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore the live preview override lookup in getContentByKey. The hook should check for preview overrides before falling back to published content via getValue, as the prescribed fix states: 'merge defaultContent with live preview updates' so all downstream consumers re-render.

issues.description: No server-side Contentstack Stack initialization with live_preview configuration. The prescribed fix requires `live_preview: { enable: true, preview_token: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, host: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST }` so that preview queries return draft content. Without this, the SDK may initialize on the client but the Contentstack API will never return draft/preview content, making the entire feature non-functional end-to-end.
issues.suggestedFix: Locate the Contentstack Stack initialization (likely in cx-shared or an API util) and add the live_preview configuration object with preview_token and host from environment variables.

issues.description: useLivePreviewContent is dead code — it is not consumed by any component or exported through the hooks barrel. Its implementation also has the same onEntryChange discard bug (`setContent((prev) => ({ ...prev } as T))`). This adds complexity without meeting any acceptance criterion.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove useLivePreviewContent entirely. The live preview subscription should live in ContentstackProvider (the single source of content truth) per the prescribed fix, not in a separate hook that nobody calls.

issues.description: No unit tests exist for any of the 4 changed files. resolve_test_file confirmed zero test files for contentstackContext.tsx, useContent.ts, ContentstackLink.tsx, or contentCard.ts. The review criteria require new features to have corresponding vitest unit tests mirroring the src/ path, and the total test count must not decrease. None of the 7 acceptance criteria are covered by tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Add unit tests for: (1) ContentstackProvider — verifies onEntryChange triggers re-render with updated content, verifies fallback to defaultContent when preview inactive, verifies cleanup on unmount; (2) useContent — verifies getContentByKey returns preview overrides when present and falls back to published content; (3) ContentstackLink — verifies data-cslp attribute in preview mode, verifies link renders published content in production.

issues.description: Unused variable `context` — `const context = useContext(ContentstackContext)` is declared but never read. This is a TypeScript strict compliance issue (noUnusedLocals) and indicates the component was not properly refactored. The component also duplicates preview detection logic (window.location.search.includes) that should live in the provider.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the unused `context` variable. Move preview detection into ContentstackProvider and expose `isPreviewEnabled` through context so components don't hand-roll URL parsing.

issues.description: Hardcoded string literals `"live_preview"` and `"preview_token"` for URL parameter detection. Review criteria require no hardcoded strings for file paths, endpoints, or configuration keys — all should use named constants from src/config/constants.ts.
issues.suggestedFix: Define LIVE_PREVIEW_QUERY_PARAM and PREVIEW_TOKEN_QUERY_PARAM constants in src/config/constants.ts and import them.

issues.description: ContentstackLivePreview.init() is called unconditionally on every page load, including production. The prescribed fix says preview should only activate when a preview session is active. This risks errors on production pages and violates AC: 'On a production page with no Contentstack Live Preview session active, the page renders all content as static published content with no visible Live Preview indicators.'
issues.suggestedFix: Guard the init() call with a check for preview URL parameters, or use the SDK's own detection mechanism. Only subscribe to onEntryChange when a preview session is active.

issues.description: `footer?: [any]` uses untyped `any` without an explanatory comment. TypeScript strict compliance requires no untyped `any` without justification.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace with a proper interface type for the footer content structure, or add an explanatory comment if the type is genuinely unknown.
